page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-hypervised server features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. It is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes no local storage and does not feature a GPU. Network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU scoring 3074.67 and Geekbench single-core reaching 2000.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is average, as shown by a Geekbench multi-core score of 7722.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 14487.06. Memory performance is mixed; while small-block cached read bandwidth is average at 607.06 GB/sec, large-block uncached read bandwidth is weak, measuring 38.79 GB/sec. Text processing performance is strong, whereas database operations, static web serving, and Redis SET operations fall into the average category.

The instance offers a balanced resource profile for general-purpose workloads, delivering dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of hyperthreading. The lack of local storage requires external block storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff. Given its strong single-core capabilities and average multi-core and memory bandwidth, this server is suitable for application servers, static web serving, text processing pipelines, and software compilation tasks.
